description: Scales a signal to a chosen output range, taking the lowest and the highest voltages it has been given so far as the bottom and the top of the input range

params.text: Sets the voltage that the lowest input recorded so far comes out as, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage that the highest input recorded so far comes out as, -10V to 10V
Clears the recorded lowest and highest input voltages, so the range is learned again from whatever arrives next
Stops the recorded lowest and highest input voltages from being updated. The lamp lights while it is on, and an input beyond either recorded end comes out at the min or the max knob's voltage
Gives each channel its own pair of recorded lowest and highest voltages, rather than one pair taken from every channel together. The lamp lights while it is on, and pressing it clears the record

inputs.text: The signal to be scaled; the number of channels here sets the number of channels at out

outputs.text: The lowest input voltage recorded so far
The highest input voltage recorded so far
The input scaled so that the lowest voltage recorded so far comes out at the min knob and the highest at the max knob, and clamped between those two knobs

notes: before any signal arrives the recorded lowest is 11V and the recorded highest is -11V, so the min output reads 11V and the max output reads -11V.
while the recorded lowest and highest are the same voltage, which is the case until the input has moved at all, out carries the min knob's voltage.
the min and max outputs carry one channel each unless poly is on, when they carry as many channels as the input.
the recorded lowest and highest are saved with the patch, so a patch comes back with the range it had already learned.
